SELECT id, name, parent_id AS parentId, standard_life_months AS standardLifeMonths, sort_order AS sortOrder, is_deleted AS isDeleted, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM asset_category WHERE is_deleted = 0
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND parent_id = #{parentId}
ORDER BY sort_order ASC
